title: UPSC 11/2026 Various Posts Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy): 04; Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine): 60; Assistant Editor: 02; Specialist Grade II (Junior Scale) - Anesthesiology: 01; Specialist Grade II (Junior Scale) - Pediatrics: 01; Assistant Public Prosecutor: 140; Public Law Officer / District Litigation Officer / Law Officer: 04
qualification: Post-wise educational and experience criteria are given in the official UPSC notification. Candidates must have the prescribed medical, academic, law, journalism or specialist qualification and relevant work experience as applicable.
ageLimit: Post-wise age limit. Age relaxation is applicable as per UPSC rules and government norms. Check the official notification for the complete age-detail table.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS: ₹25/-; SC / ST / All Female: ₹0/-; PH: ₹0/-. Fee can be paid through debit card, credit card, internet banking, IMPS, cash card or mobile wallet.
selectionProcess: Written Examination → Interview → Document Verification → Medical Examination
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photograph, signature, identity proof, experience certificate, category certificate if applicable, and all documents mentioned in the official UPSC notification
howToApply:
1. Visit the official UPSC online application portal at https://upsconline.nic.in/
2. Complete One Time Registration if not already done
3. Open the UPSC 11/2026 Various Posts recruitment form
4. Fill the required details, upload documents and pay the fee
5. Submit the application before 02 October 2026 and keep a copy of the final submitted form
shortDescription: UPSC has issued the recruitment notification for 11/2026 Various Posts with 212 vacancies. Apply online from 12 September 2026 to 02 October 2026 and read the official notification carefully before applying.
content:
Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the Advt. No. 11/2026 notification for UPSC 11/2026 Various Posts recruitment.

The recruitment has 212 vacancies and invites applications for posts such as Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy), Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine), Assistant Editor, Specialist Grade II Junior Scale Anesthesiology, Specialist Grade-II Junior Scale Pediatrics, Assistant Public Prosecutor, and Public Law Officer / District Litigation Officer / Law Officer.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date: 12 September 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date: 02 October 2026
  • Last Date (For UT of Ladakh Post): 09 October 2026
  • Exam Date: Notify Later
  • Admit Card: Before Exam
  • Result Date: Will Be Updated Here Soon

Candidates must verify post-wise eligibility, category-wise fee, age criteria and required experience before submitting the application. Download the official notification and carefully review the scan / uploaded details before final submission.
